latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Clarify DataLoader DI setup and listener behavior by @yuliuyi717-ux in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4385
* Fix handling of directive arguments with default values by @jbellenger in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4437
* Fix self-referencing input type default values throwing circular dependency error by @Shane32 with @Copilot in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4445
* Fix recursively referenced input object not initializing all field default values by @Shane32 in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4447
* Fix inlining issues with GetCallingAssembly by @tompazourek in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4455
* GQL009 support ternary operator by @gao-artur in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4490
* Fix Encoding.UTF8.GetChars use by @Shane32 in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4485

## New Contributors
* @yuliuyi717-ux made their first contribution in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4385
* @jbellenger made their first contribution in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4437
* @tompazourek made their first contribution in https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/pull/4455

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/graphql-dotnet/graphql-dotnet/compare/8.8.4...8.8.5
